confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Tel Aviv price levels for a July peak-season window; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant, cafe, and beer anchors are moderately reliable. The cocktail and wine_glass anchors were set relative to the beer anchor, both somewhat higher, because direct knowledge of bar prices is weaker. Hostel and hotel anchors are least certain: peak-summer rates shift with demand and with regional security conditions that may have changed after the model's knowledge cutoff. Shekel exchange-rate movement adds uncertainty to all USD figures.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Tel Aviv treated as a high-cost Eastern Mediterranean coastal city with Western-style dining and hotel prices. Restaurant and cafe levels were judged roughly in line with high-cost Southern European coastal cities, and accommodation was set for July peak demand rather than off-season rates.

anchor_basis.beer: Goldstar or Maccabee draft, 400 ml at a neighborhood restaurant, about 35 ILS
anchor_basis.coffee: Cappuccino at a local independent cafe, about 22 ILS

anchor_basis.cocktail: Classic-style cocktail at a bar in Florentin or Rothschild, about 52 ILS
anchor_basis.wine_glass: House white or red, 150 ml pour at a mid-range restaurant, about 42 ILS

anchor_basis.hotel_3star_2p: Standard double in a registered three-star hotel, peak-summer rate about 910 ILS per night
